# YuGiMob

> Extensions for the pi coding agent: anchored edits, keyless web tools, Tor routing, review workflows, and a human gate in front of every commit.

Data refreshed 2026-10-13.

I build extensions for pi, the terminal coding agent. Each one takes a class of mistake that instructions alone cannot reliably prevent and moves it into the tool, where it is impossible, refused, or visible.

Five tools, five rules: edit by identity, fetch without a key, hide the origin, keep the plan outside the conversation, and put a human in front of the commit.

The source is on GitHub, the page is hand-written and static, and the numbers refresh daily from the GitHub and npm APIs.

## Tools

- [pi-hashline-edit-pro](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-hashline-edit-pro): Every line a tool serves gets its own four-letter anchor. Install: `pi install npm:pi-hashline-edit-pro`. Stars 109, 4,506 npm installs per week.
- [pi-unsloth-webtools](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-unsloth-webtools): Two keyless tools: web_search sweeps DuckDuckGo and Startpage by default and fuses their rankings; web_fetch normalizes a URL, extracts HTML or PDF text to Markdown with page metadata, and retries a refusal through a browser-fingerprint transport. Install: `pi install npm:pi-unsloth-webtools`. Stars 2, 343 npm installs per week.
- [pi-tor-proxy](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-tor-proxy): The extension manages its own Tor binary and routes every request through it. Install: `pi install npm:pi-tor-proxy`. Stars 3, 15 npm installs per week.
- [pi-msg-workflow](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-msg-workflow): Numbered message and command stores live in editable files, so the plan does not depend on the context window. Install: `pi install npm:pi-msg-workflow`. Stars 1, 9 npm installs per week.
- [pi-git-commit](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-git-commit): The bash guard blocks mutative git commands before they run. Install: `pi install npm:pi-git-commit`. Stars 2, 539 npm installs per week.

## Data

- [Markdown mirror](https://yugimob.github.io/index.md): the whole page as markdown, generated from the two data files
- [Machine data](https://yugimob.github.io/data/site-data.json): stars, downloads, activity, and history, refreshed daily
- [Curated showcase](https://yugimob.github.io/data/showcase.json): the rules behind every tool, one entry per extension
- [Agent readability](https://yugimob.github.io/agent-readability.json): the machine-readable entry points this site publishes
- [Feed](https://yugimob.github.io/feed.json): a JSON Feed of the daily install and star snapshots
- [Sitemap](https://yugimob.github.io/sitemap.xml): the single canonical page

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/YuGiMob/yugimob.github.io): the hand-written page and the refresh pipeline that derives these files
